recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless the work group deliberately wants to move or duplicate the existing Search page guidance into the CapabilityStatement element definition as an editorial restructuring.
issue_request: FHIR-30631 was a Published FHIR-core change request resolved as Persuasive with Modification. It asked how a CapabilityStatement should express support for search modifiers such as code:in and whether referencing a base SearchParameter implies modifier support.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 9aed2168cb9c41336947ce1c6ba438be49116a20, which added the modifier conformance guidance to source/search.html under Standard Parameters. That commit is contained in v5.0.0, consistent with the Jira Applied for Version R5.
additional_context: The final 2022 Jira resolution and FHIR-I minutes superseded an earlier 2021 wording. Zulip discussion of FHIR-30631 confirms the same model: unsupported modifiers require defining a custom SearchParameter based on the official one. Current CapabilityStatement searchParam.definition comments also direct implementations to SearchParameter resources for modifier and comparator documentation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Search page already says that a referenced base SearchParameter that does not enumerate modifiers and comparators implies support for all permitted modifiers and prefixes for the search type, and that restricting modifiers requires a local SearchParameter whose definition is available via [base]/SearchParameter or contained in CapabilityStatement.

evidence_items.learned: The final decision requires guidance that base SearchParameter references imply support for permitted modifiers/comparators unless a local SearchParameter restricts them.
